correctness.rationale: A complete unrestricted proof uses signed cycle edge differences, duality, sign-symmetry averaging over all quadratic forms, exact Cauchy–Schwarz and convex endpoint extrema, and a unique monotone crossing. The rational checker ran successfully for eight ratios, as supplementary evidence, not infinite proof.

A coincident numerical constant 5/3 at selected parameters does not imply equality of full parameter-dependent statements.

originality.rationale: Specific five semantic record searches and full texts of the three closest publicly indexed cycle-Hilbert claims, plus accessible primary finite-free-space articles, yielded no theorem implying the two-alternating-edge exact profile. Uniform and one-defect cases are acknowledged, and unindexed equivalent convex-geometric computations remain a residual risk.
